g.text: Swarm vocabulary: cluster, node, manager, worker, service, task
You declare what you want (a service). Swarm keeps making it true.
Swarm = a cluster of nodes managed as one
keeps the cluster records (Raft), decides what runs where.
(also called a replica): web.1 web.2 web.3
Swarm places each on a node
If a node dies, the manager notices and starts its tasks elsewhere: that is "desired state". db.1 is a different service with 1 replica.
